description: The 19-query open-web sweep found no source describing a January 2023 physical public protest in Eritrea with an own-state target. The observed result set cannot establish that no such protest occurred; search-engine coverage and recall are unknown.
required_followup: Coordinator review and, if warranted, searches of additional period-specific news archives and contemporaneous original records; keep the result as not identified by this bounded sweep, not a zero-protest conclusion.

description: Open-web search does not reproduce the codebook-described Lexis-Nexis workflow or its newspaper selection, terms, date controls, and expansion thresholds. No claim of equivalent or exhaustive coverage is supported.
required_followup: Reconcile against the official current baseline and any available licensed archive; retain the method deviation until verified.

description: Coverage included English queries, one Tigrinya query, one Arabic query, and searches scoped to Shabait, BBC Tigrinya, Asmarino, Assenna, and Radio Erena. This is not broad coverage of Eritrean-language reporting or of in-country and diaspora archives; search indexing and translations remain uncertain.
required_followup: If further review is needed, consult additional original-language reporting and relevant local or regional archives with competent language review; record exact terms and limits.

description: The January 19, 2023 EEPA Horn report (S001) remained search-only after a web-open Internal Error and a separately gated ordinary HTTPS request that failed DNS resolution (curl exit 6, HTTP 000, zero bytes). No HTTP denial or report content was observed.
required_followup: No further retrieval was attempted. Any later attempt requires a fresh source-scope review and an open source window; otherwise retain as inaccessible due to technical failure, not denial.

description: The available local May 2015 MM Codebook reading copy was reviewed, but the additional Mass Mobilization Coding Procedure and a verified current official baseline, universe, and applicable use conditions remain unavailable.
required_followup: Coordinator-owned baseline verification and retrieval of the additional procedure before official coding or integration.

description: December 2022 and February 2023 continuity searches did not identify a qualifying physical protest episode to assign across a month boundary. If an episode exists outside indexed sources, its start, end, state target, and ownership remain unknown; report dates were not used as event dates.
required_followup: Review adjacent-month units and contemporaneous sources if a specific episode is identified; do not create a continuation from state mobilization references alone.
